criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame rendered in a world, 1 and 7 strongest, 2 and 9 convincing rooms. The fly is still a primitive on four frames, frame 6 misreads as a cork with beads, frame 5's trees break the parapet logic, frame 4 a flat page, frame 9's third flag runs off the board.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One hero, one accent held to the machine's frames, both devices work, cuts land at world changes. Frame 6 and frame 4 sit slightly outside.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral and drawn count checks and the fact check's discipline holds. The first comment is stale against round 4 (missing c11 and c12, carrying c23 and a c46-only entry), frame 6 draws flies on their backs that no claim states, journal links are Europe PMC REST JSON.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where traced to c1, and a concrete next step in the source's own terms. No invented deadline.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, the turn lands on 6, close on an action. Frames 3 and 5 could fold into one.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, house rules hold, honest lines. Frame 7's 'them' ambiguous, thin Texas specificity.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: First genetics deck with a new world. One object through every frame repeats nos. 38 and 39.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild the fly as a real insect model and reframe frame 6, and regenerate the stale sources block.
